provider failure leaves no active account, session or consumed/new challenge

wrong refresh app/device cannot steal or revoke the valid family

branch-scoped staff cannot read another branch, list global roles, provision accounts, or self-escalate

role CRUD and grants work internally; live permission changes apply to an existing access token
disabling staff revokes access/refresh/challenges and customer tokens never authorize admin routes

rate limits persist in PostgreSQL; spoofed forwarding headers cannot bypass IP limits
Helmet, exact CORS, JSON/body validation and request IDs remain safe; no phase06 endpoints
readiness checks real DB role and OTP independently; an unconfigured provider cannot issue OTP
OpenAPI exposes the implemented subset with strict inputs and no code/debug backdoor
every protected sub-route rejects missing identity before any read or mutation
last general admin grant and role cannot be removed or disabled by another manager
readiness fails closed for unconfigured OTP, unavailable DB and unsafe migration owner
failed resend preserves the old OTP and pending registration instead of reporting delivery success
deleted identities, revoked sessions and expired refresh families reject access
grant provisioning removes stale column-level privacy privileges as well as table privileges
environment rejects wildcard CORS and accepts an empty unused gateway URL without enabling a provider
address PATCH changes only supplied fields and rejects an empty patch or forged owner
real HTTP responses exercised by the suite conform to the published OpenAPI schemas
explicit bootstrap provisions one pending general admin without a default password or bypassing OTP
operator auth housekeeping clears expired secrets and rate buckets while retaining audit and identities
HTTPS gateway transport enforces TLS, rejects redirects/errors/timeouts and does not forward passwords
